answer: Because the gale collateral is checked against the quill claim at intake, the garden audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. Posted collateral must equal 7 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases therefore has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. That is 16 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
